mechanism.claim: A large signed shift in the median one-minute return from the first half to the second half of a volatile completed BTC spot auction identifies broad unlevered cash repricing rather than a few extreme candles; follow the cash location-shift direction for eight hours.
mechanism.side: strict sign of spot median shift
mechanism.why_distinct: Prior spot/perpetual candidates use endpoint returns, basis, ranges, flow, volume timing, or filter perpetual events. HVSMRSR ranks the full-panel actual spot robust return-location transition and creates its own onset clock, with no reused event set, OI, funding, premium, options, fitted outcome, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: irregular actual-cash robust distribution-shift onsets are absent from Gross9

features.spot_shift: second-half minus first-half median of 480 exact completed one-minute spot log(close/open) returns, finite strict nonzero
features.shift_rank: strict-prior midrank of abs(spot_shift) over at most 270 jointly valid decisions, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.75
features.onset: eligible now and immediately prior exact eight-hour jointly valid decision ineligible; missing prior cannot trigger

clock.reservation: onsets are half-open nonoverlapping; exit first on equal entry
clock.funding: not signal input; exact settlements only after source and Gross9 pass

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

research_boundary.classification: exploratory discovery; not fresh confirmatory evidence

stopping_rule: source, Gross9, train/test/eval/final; terminal first failure; no venue, half partition, median, shift, history, rank, onset, variation, side, clock, hold, subset, comparator, or control repair
